question: Five Deputy Ministers have been appointed in which of the following States in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2019, Andhra Pradesh made a significant move by appointing five Deputy Chief Ministers.**
 
• This was a first-of-its-kind decision in the state's history, made by Chief Minister **Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy**.
 
• The five Deputy Chief Ministers were appointed to represent various communities, ensuring inclusivity and social justice in governance.
 
• These Deputy Chief Ministers were:
 
 
• **Pamula Pushpa Sreevani** (Tribal Welfare)
 
• **Alla Kali Krishna Srinivas** (Health and Family Welfare)
 
• **K Narayana Swamy** (Excise and Commercial Taxes)
 
• **Amzath Basha Shaik Bepari** (Minority Welfare)
 
• **Ch. Venugopala Krishna** (Revenue)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **deputy minister works under a cabinet minister**, who is a senior minister in charge of a policy portfolio. 
 
• A deputy minister **may also be a junior minister who assists a cabinet minister. **
 
• **In some cases, a deputy minister may be a cabinet minister who acts on behalf of a more **senior cabinet minister. 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel **was the first Deputy Prime Minister of India.
 
 
• He served from 1947 until his death in 1950.
 
• Patel was a prominent leader of the Indian National Congress party.
 
• He is known as the "Father of Fundamental Rights in India".
